- en-US: English.
The ID of the coupon template.

description.zh:
是否使用POC优惠券额度
ture：使用POC优惠券额度，如果所有提交的账号都标记为免审批，则当前的优惠券申请将跳过审批流程，您的伙伴权益包中的POC优惠券配额将被扣除；
false：不使用POC优惠券额度，无论提交账号的免审批状态如何，您的POC优惠券权益配额将保持不变，在这种情况下，申请将遵循标准的优惠券申请审批流程
description.en:
Specifies whether to use the POC coupon quota. Valid values:
- true: Uses the POC coupon quota. If all submitted accounts are marked as approval-exempt, the current coupon application skips the approval process, and the POC coupon quota in your partner benefit package is deducted.
- false: Does not use the POC coupon quota. Regardless of the approval-exempt status of the submitted accounts, your POC coupon privilege quota remains unchanged. In this case, the application follows the standard coupon application approval process.
